description_en: Queries the execution logs of Spark code
kebab_example: aliyun adb describe-spark-code-log --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-cluster-id amv-uf6o6m8p6x7v0000 --job-id 1248 --api-version 2021-12-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeSparkCodeLog

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the cluster
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Lakehouse Edition cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html operation to query the IDs of all AnalyticDB for MySQL clusters within a region
parameters.help_zh:
<props="china">企业版、基础版或湖仓版集群ID。</props>
<props="intl">湖仓版集群ID。</props>

调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/454250.html接口可以查看集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Spark job
parameters.name: job_id

Log.example: >>>>>>>> stdout:n++++++++++++++++++executing sql: MSCK REPAIR TABLE  `footprint_ethereum`.`dwd_eth_eth_txr_v2_di` n++n

Message.description_en:
The returned message.

If the request was successful, Success is returned.
If the request failed, an error message is returned
Message.description_zh:
调用结果的附加信息。取值说明：
请求正常，返回Success。 
请求异常，返回具体异常错误码

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the request was successful. Valid values:

true
false
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功，取值说明：
true：成功。
false：失败
